evals.prompt: Create a level 5 half-elf bard for my campaign
evals.expected_output: A complete player character JSON with half-elf racial traits, bard class features through level 5, rolled ability scores, spells, equipment, and personality

assertions.name: valid_json
assertions.description: Output is parseable JSON

assertions.name: correct_schema
assertions.description: Uses nested player_character schema with identity, ability_scores, combat, proficiencies, features, equipment, spellcasting, personality sections

assertions.name: correct_race
assertions.description: Race is Half-Elf with Cha +2 and two other ability scores +1

assertions.name: correct_class_level
assertions.description: Class is Bard, level is 5

assertions.name: hp_calculation
assertions.description: HP is plausible for a level 5 bard (d8 hit die): roughly 20-43 range depending on Con

assertions.name: has_spellcasting
assertions.description: Includes cantrips and spell slots appropriate for a 5th-level bard (3 cantrips, slots up to 3rd level)

assertions.name: has_personality
assertions.description: Personality section includes traits, ideals, bonds, and flaws that are specific

evals.prompt: I need a CR 3 bandit leader NPC with a stat block for an ambush encounter
evals.expected_output: A combat NPC JSON stat block at CR 3 with appropriate HP, AC, actions, and tactical notes for an ambush scenario

assertions.name: valid_json
assertions.description: Output is parseable JSON

assertions.name: correct_schema
assertions.description: Uses nested combat_npc schema with identity, challenge, combat, ability_scores, actions sections

assertions.name: correct_cr
assertions.description: Challenge rating is 3

assertions.name: has_actions
assertions.description: At least one attack action with to-hit bonus and damage

assertions.name: has_tactical_notes
assertions.description: Includes tactical or ambush-relevant notes

assertions.name: plausible_stats
assertions.description: HP roughly 50-85 and AC roughly 13-17, appropriate for CR 3

evals.prompt: Generate a mysterious shopkeeper NPC for a magic item store in a port city
evals.expected_output: A roleplay NPC JSON with personality, motivations, speech pattern, secrets, appearance, and plot hooks fitting a mysterious magic shop owner in a port setting

assertions.name: valid_json
assertions.description: Output is parseable JSON

assertions.name: correct_schema
assertions.description: Uses nested roleplay_npc schema with identity, personality, appearance, secrets, relationships, plot_hooks sections

assertions.name: has_motivation
assertions.description: Primary motivation field is populated with a specific motivation

assertions.name: has_speech_pattern
assertions.description: Speech pattern is described with example dialogue

assertions.name: has_secrets
assertions.description: At least one secret with a discovery method

assertions.name: has_plot_hooks
assertions.description: At least one plot hook

assertions.name: fits_theme
assertions.description: Content specifically relates to a port city magic shop, not a generic NPC
